title: About: Mehedi Hasan, Founder | MonoBook
description: MonoBook, founded in 2022, is a brand identity studio run by Mehedi Hasan from Satkhira, Bangladesh. Your contact from first email to final file.

paras: MonoBook was founded in 2022 as a design studio. Mehedi Hasan, founder and CEO, started this work in 2016 and is your contact from the first email to the final file.
Our aim is to deliver ideas and work that hold significance for the people we work with. We work openly, transparently and together with you.
The studio is in Satkhira, Bangladesh, and works with you by email and video call. You hear back within two hours, UK working hours.
